name: Slope
source:
Mai transfers into all girl highschool to break free from ordinary school life and to experience everything that a girl school can give, including lesbian relationships.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
舞转入一所女子高中，希望摆脱平凡的校园生活，体验女校所能带来的一切，其中也包括女同性恋关系。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
